description_en: A 90-degree bent tube using sweep along arc path
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
tube_od = 25      # 管外径 (mm)
tube_id = 20      # 管内径 (mm)
bend_r = 50       # 弯曲半径 (mm)
straight_a = 40   # 入口直管长 (mm)
straight_b = 40   # 出口直管长 (mm)

# === 路径: 直管 + 90度弯 + 直管 ===
path = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(0, straight_a)
    .radiusArc((bend_r, straight_a + bend_r), -bend_r)
    .lineTo(bend_r + straight_b, straight_a + bend_r)
)

# === 外管 ===
outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(tube_od / 2)
    .sweep(path)
)

# === 内孔 ===
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(tube_id / 2)
    .sweep(path)
)

result = outer.cut(inner)

show_object(result)
